title: The freeze is a rule held by review, not a gate
situation: Record corrections, second cold read, 2026-10-13: 0143 still said only the architect changes a frozen cut's checks, which 0160 gave to the lead and check-writer.
decision: The freeze stands as a rule: while a cut is built, only the architect changes its examples and the concepts they illustrate, and only the lead and its check-writer the checks that bind them. It is held by the assayers' review of the change and by the record of who changed what; nothing refuses it.
consequences: The freeze concept states the same.
